newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB drops October 96/97 wheat, feed barley PROs.
newsitem.headline: CWB drops October 96/97 wheat, feed barley PROs.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board dropped its October Pool Return Outlook wheat and feed barley price forecasts for the 1996/97 (August/July) crop year by $10 to $16 a tonne in wheat and $7 a tonne in feed barley on good world output prospects, the CWB said in a statement.
The PROs are a monthly Board estimate of world prices but not connected to CWB initial payments to farmers.
Benchmark No1 Canada Western Red Spring Wheat PROs dropped to the $203-$223 range from the $217-$237 range in September.
No1 Canada Western Feed Barley fell to $143-$163 from $150-$170 range in September.
Special select Canada Western Two-Row Malting Barley price estimates remained unchanged at the $225-$245 range. Special select Canada Western Six-Row Malt barley also were unchanged at $185-$205.
No1 Canada Western Amber Durum wheat remained unchanged at $205-$235.

The CWB said wheat prices dropped on continued favourable production prospects in Australia and Argentina's wheat crops. World wheat production was estimated at 573 million tonnes, the second largest on record. European Union output was pegged at a record 99 million tonnes, up from 86 million last year.
Price declines in corn weighed on feed wheat and No5 Canada Western Amber Durum values.

Feed barley prices fell this month on EU barley export subsidies. EU output was estimated at 53 million tonnes, the highest since 1991/92. Prices also declined on larger U.S. corn production estimates and a large Australian barley crop.
A strong Canadian dollar was a factor in the downward revision of the world price forecast, the CWB added.
Pool returns in Canadian dollars per tonne based on grain in store St. Lawrence or Vancouver:

CWRS=Canada Western Spring Wheat. CPSR=Canada Prairie Spring Red. CPSW=Canada Prairie Spring White. CWRW= Canada Western Red Winter. CWES=Canada Western Extra Strong. CWSWS=Canada Western Soft White Spring. CWF=Canada Western Feed. CWAD=Canada Western Amber Durum. CW=Canada Western. SS=Special Select.
